**Problem:** `src/server.ts` referenced `McpError` and its `.code` field — a class retired in `@modelcontextprotocol/server` v2 (which the project depends on, `^2.0.0`).

**Fix:** Migrated the error handling to the current v2 error hierarchy. Inspecting the bundled SDK source confirmed `McpError` was renamed to `SdkError` (constructor `(code, message, data)`, with `.code` carrying `SdkErrorCode` values; `SdkHttpError` extends it adding `.status`/`.statusText`). ```ts
import { McpServer, SdkError } from '@modelcontextprotocol/server';
try { throw new Error('boom'); } catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof SdkError) console.log(error.code);
}
```

- `node src/server.ts` loads and runs cleanly
